title: Documentation Drift Review traceability eval
objective: Measure whether the review verifies high-impact documentation claims against package scripts, config, routes, and real paths and supplies exact corrections.
prompt: Use the Documentation Drift Review craftbook for the weekly docs-health pass. Compare the seeded docs with the code/config and write tasks/eval/documentation-drift-review.md. Do not edit documentation.

setup.about: A small service whose README and runbook contain deliberate command, port, endpoint, path, and recovery drift.
setup.missionObjectives: Cite both the stale doc location and source of truth, include exact corrected wording, and rank harmful operational drift first.

files.content:
# Returns Service

Run `npm start` and open http://localhost:3000. List customers with `GET /customers`. See [setup](docs/setup.md).

# Recovery

If the queue stalls, delete `runtime.db` and restart. The service will rebuild all pending jobs from memory.

export const port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 8080);
export const stateFile = process.env.STATE_FILE ?? 'data/queue.sqlite';
app.get('/users', requireUser, async (_req, res) => res.json(await store.listUsers()));

// data/queue.sqlite is the durable source of truth; deleting it loses pending jobs.
export async function recover(db) { return db.pending(); }
